changelog:
- Introduced experience-driven procedures: workflows now auto-evolve from failures and adapt based on user feedback.
- Added two new scripts: mengram-feedback.sh for recording workflow outcome (success/failure with context), and mengram-procedures.sh for listing and inspecting all learned procedures.
- Procedures now support automatic version history and evolution logs, with feedback triggering improvements.
- Updated documentation to reflect new feedback and procedure management features.
- Enhanced guidance on when to provide feedback and how to interact with self-improving workflows.
summary: Long-term memory with 3 types (facts, events, workflows). Self-improving procedures that evolve from failures. Remember user preferences, past conversations,...
